notes: PARENT-TOO-OLD, LIKELY A REAL LATE-LIFE BIRTH NOT AN ERROR (folding in this repo's own gen07-john-murray.md research, 2026-07-04): Liza (Eliza) Chambers (b. ~1752 Scotland) is independently documented via WikiTree Murray-2863 (citing NBGS-Miramichi archival files) as the real mother of John Murray (b. 1791, this repo's gen 7 direct-line ancestor) within a well-attested Scots family (Canonbie, Dumfriesshire) that settled PEI then Tabusintac, NB by 1799-1803. Her age at Alexander Murray's 1806 birth (~54) is at the edge of plausibility but not impossible, and the family's other children (Ann 1793, George 1795, Hugh 1797, John 1791) form a normal spacing pattern consistent with her being an adult by the 1790 marriage. Not independently re-verified this pass; flagged as probably-fine rather than re-researched from scratch, since the family's core identity is already externally corroborated. See docs/research/ancestors/gen07-john-murray.md.
